## Context / Problem

Private re-exports, wrappers, and alias assignments survive after ownership moved elsewhere. Their only beneficiaries are repository imports, strings, and monkeypatch targets, so they create a second binding without protecting a public compatibility contract. The approved policy requires every such consumer to migrate and prohibits new internal-only shims.

## Approach

A prerequisite ADR establishes the boundary and enforcement policy. After it merges, disjoint children migrate all source, tests, dynamic imports, string lookups, and monkeypatch consumers by subsystem and delete the old binding. Public facades, MCP wire schemas, event readers, and persisted-data migrations remain separate contracts.

## Child Decomposition

- The ADR child performs RESEARCH, DRAFT, HOLD, and MERGE for the no-internal-shim rule.
- Core/reconciler, CLI/security/graph/grounding, and LLM/workflow/MCP-model children own disjoint migration censuses.
- The LLM/workflow shard also owns approved SDC3 alias migrations.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] A merged ADR defines one canonical binding after private moves, atomic consumer migration, valid exceptions, and recurrence prevention.
- [x] Every enumerated internal shim has its semantic/static and string/dynamic/monkeypatch consumers moved to its canonical owner.
- [x] No old private binding remains solely for internal compatibility.
- [x] Deliberate public facades, wire schemas, event readers, and persisted-data migrations retain their independently specified contracts.

## Close verification evidence (2026-09-05)

Verified on origin/main 59d504c2bdbb before close.

- AC1: ADR 0111 is accepted in docs/adr/0111-no-internal-only-compatibility-shims.md and defines one canonical private binding, atomic migration of source/test/string/dynamic/monkeypatch consumers, public/wire/data exceptions, and recurrence-prevention evidence. docs/api-stability.md and docs/architecture.md cite it as current policy.
- AC2: child stories 2164, 3a46, 8eff, e54e, and a691 are closed and merged. Focused current-tree tests passed: tests/scripts/test_internal_shim_policy_docs.py, tests/unit/test_llm_internal_shim_removal_2164.py, tests/unit/test_internal_shims_removed_3a46.py, tests/interfaces/facades/test_internal_shim_removal_e54e_heldout.py, tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_internal_shim_removal.py, and tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_model_schema_drift_heldout.py (36 passed).
- AC3: spot census confirms old private shim names are absent from their old owners: failure_usage removed in favor of run_shape; run_security_detectors absent except historical docs/tests asserting absence; event_append/event_commit_git lack _is_transient_add_error; close_precheck/transition_close lack _referencing_commit_exists; apply_inbound_records lacks _inbound_update_write_edit_event; reconcile.py no longer binds the enumerated moved helper/runtime names and resolves canonical modules at call time; Mode.rank is absent.
- AC4: preserved contracts remain intentionally live: public Python facade re-exports are in src/rebar/__init__.py; MCP wire models live in src/rebar/_mcp_models.py and mcp_server no longer re-exports them; event compatibility is preserved by src/rebar/reducer/_version.py preserve-and-ignore semantics; workflow migration APIs remain in rebar.llm.workflow.
